result_text:
The "Undefined Team" now only collects active contributors. I only compiled `codeanalyzer`, which succeeded. I didn't run any tests or add one for this case.

The change is one added condition in `getAllTeams()` in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/landscape/analysis/LandscapeAnalysisResults.java`. A contributor matched by no team now goes into the remainder only if `contributor.getContributor().isActive()` is true.

- **Blank dates:** `Contributor.isActive()` already treats a blank latest-commit date as active, so nobody is dropped for missing data.
- **Configured teams:** they are untouched and keep all their members, active or not.
- **Dormant unmatched contributors:** they now appear in no team at all.
